manifestations.invariant: After an overweight bump at gate close, reserve units and next sailing position are preserved while fare posts exactly once.

contract_bindings.quote: Deferred capacity is recomputed from the recorded weight classes of bumped vehicles.
A bumped vehicle retains its queue position when it is moved to the next sailing.
